# Lithuania crop fields

Lithuania field boundaries (2024) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Nacionalinė mokėjimo agentūra prie Žemės ūkio ministerijos <https://www.nma.lt>, Europe-LAND HE Project. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lt/latest/lt.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/lt/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:3035; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: hcat:code, id, geometry, hcat:name_en, crop:code, metrics:area, crop:name, hcat:name, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lt/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lt/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lt/collection.json
